products.descriptionHtml:
What's included

  • One saree
  • One unstitched blouse piece

Botanical circular motifs with a patterned border and pallu (decorative draped end) define this banarasi silk saree. The pista green palette makes it an expressive option for wedding celebrations.

Fabric and design

  • Saree fabric: Banarasi Silk.
  • Color: Pista Green.
  • Detailing: hand work.
  • Design: Botanical circular motifs with a patterned border and pallu.

Included pieces

One saree with an unstitched blouse piece. The fitted blouse shown on the model illustrates styling; the included blouse fabric requires tailoring. Jewelry and other styling accessories are not included.

Fit and styling

This is a draped saree and blouse-fabric offering, not a standard-size stitched outfit. Blouse stitching, a petticoat and pre-pleating are not included in the base price. For an event-ready look, pair the detailed border with simple jewelry and arrange the pallu to show its pattern.

Before ordering

Confirm blouse-fabric measurements and any tailoring requirements before ordering. For a fixed event date, check current availability and delivery timing with LuxeMia. Colors can appear slightly different with lighting and screen settings.

Optional finishing services

The base price covers the saree and unstitched blouse piece. Blouse Stitching / Alteration, Pico & Fall (edge finishing and fall attachment), and a Matching Petticoat are separate paid options in LuxeMia's service selector; they are not included in the base price. Confirm blouse measurements before stitching. Pre-pleating is not included.
